profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer - DevOps at Morningstar
profile.summary:
A motivated and results-oriented Software Engineer with a solid background in full life cycle development.  

Self-directed producer, building timelines and accountabilities for maximum performance. 

Utilizes poise, professionalism, and exceptional analytical skills to produce results.  

Competent and reliable team player who builds cohesion and partnership.

positions.title: Sr. Build Engineer
positions.description:
Develop and maintain build and deployment processes to support the Development groups.  Managed many priorities

Supported 100+ software Developers, managed 75+ builds and released applications to 150+ servers.

Upgraded Team Foundation Server 2008 to 2013.

Partnered w/development in creation of build and deployment framework currently used to deploy CDW Development groups applications. 

Trained application support team to take on deployment of website and other applications.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description:
CDW.com is a $4B a year ecommerce website which I designed and developed applications.  The development was done in C#, asp.net and SQL Server.  Projects included and not limited to:

Developed the login and password recovery applications used across all CDW e-commerce properties driving down support costs and improving security site wide.

Updated the software licensing application to efficiently processing of customers software licenses to use EDI/GIS for data transmitting and processing.
